title: #315 Face to Face
prompt: Face-to-face communication is better than other types of communication, such as letters, email, or telephone calls. To what extent do you agree with this statement?

promptSegments.text: Face-to-face communication is better than other types of communication, such as letters, email, or telephone calls.
To what extent do you agree with this statement?

requirements.en: State how far you agree or disagree.
requirements.vi: Nêu rõ mức độ đồng ý hoặc không đồng ý.

requirements.en: Support your position with two clear reasons.
requirements.vi: Bảo vệ quan điểm bằng 2 lý do rõ ràng.
